children: Texas Capital Securities launched coverage on Monarch Casino & Resort
on Wednesday with a Buy rating.

Analyst David Bain and his team believe consensus EBITDA and visible free cash flow from the casino company's two wholly owned properties, along with best-in-class management and an unlevered balance sheet, support a valuation about 20% higher than the current trading price. In addition, the potential acquisition of another casino resort was noted to create significant potential stock upside. "While we do not have direct knowledge of such, we believe MCRI could announce a third casino resort acquisition in the relative near term, broadening its investor base and augmenting its valuation, in our view," updated Bain.
Texas Capital set a $147 price target on Monarch Casino & Resort
, which was noted to not include any value for a potential transformative and accretive acquisition.
Shares of MCRI were down 0.7% in light premarket trading to $118.51. The 52-week high for the casino stock is $135.93.
